verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any bulk dataset downloads or registry extracts. The closest items are per-patent uncertified copy downloads, interactive search tools, an on-page table of average wait times, and an authenticated API at api.uspto.gov. These are single-record access, search UIs, or a keyed API, not bulk extracts that avoid scraping. The developer portal returned only a JS shell, so it adds no readable evidence of bulk data products.
